identification: Stamp lot: a loose-leaf album page of Australian definitives and a small ring-bound album with Indonesian-style/other foreign pages and modern Australian blocks plus FDCs (photo 1), and two spiral-bound exercise-book stamp books of Australian used stamps: Kangaroo and Map 1/2d, 1d (x2), 2d grey, 3d olive, 6d, 9d violet, 1/- blue-green and 2/- maroon (photo 2), KGV heads 1d red/green, 1 1/2d, 2d, 3d etc with cancels (photo 3), and QEII/Tasmania-era 1950s-60s commemoratives and animals (photo 4). Used, mostly cancelled, some perf/thinning faults.
